1.label: very_easy
1.summary: Three lanes and five short sectors show the paired-terrain idea with a generous 0.50-sector-per-second base pace and a 90-second wall-clock cap.

2.label: easy
2.summary: Four lanes and seven sectors add decoy terrain and mirrored lane choices at a measured 0.58-sector-per-second base pace with an 80.75-second cap.

3.label: medium
3.summary: Five lanes and nine sectors require a longer route plan with competing green and red choices at 0.67 base sectors per second and a 67.5-second cap.

4.label: hard
4.summary: Six lanes and twelve sectors form the baseline: every route choice moves two racers, terrain is crowded with decoys, and the 0.75 base sectors-per-second course keeps advancing during observation under a 64.6-second cap.

5.label: very_hard
5.summary: Seven lanes and fifteen sectors create the densest course: the fastest 0.98 base sectors-per-second pace and a tighter 56-second cap demand quick two-racer decisions.

simplified.description: Click the visible LEFT or RIGHT proxy button; the same mirrored steering effect is applied to both racers.

full.description: Press the task-appropriate left/right arrow keys directly while reading the two visible racers.
